g.title: callgraph
g.text: IMG-RAD-07 Photometric performance: ANALYSIS call graph (IMG_RAD_07_photometric_performance_ANALYSIS.py)
box = @pipeline_stage, oval = helper, dashed box = class instantiated, dashed arrow = passed as callback; numbers = call order in main(); hover for the full docstring

a.xlink:title: Run the IMG-RAD-07 analysis for each data state (requirement, instrument, case).

The project root (METIS_MAIT_code_eckhart/), as set in config/paths.yaml.
OUTPUTS ------- str Absolute path, ending in '/' (scripts append to it, e.g. stem + "data/").

Initialize logging with a file + console handler and pipe basic metadata.
INPUTS ---------- log_dir : str Directory where the log file should be written. log_file_name : str Full path to the output log file. now : datetime.datetime, optional Timestamp used for the "created at" log line. If None, that line is skipped.
OUTPUTS ------- None Configures the root logger and writes startup log lines.

Load the common observing config, then merge each test-specific config on top, in order (top-level keys of later files override earlier ones).
INPUTS ---------- stem : str Project root (METIS_MAIT_code_eckhart/), prepended to relative paths. *test_config_files : str Test-specific observing configs, relative to stem or absolute.
OUTPUTS ------- dict The merged observing config.

Data states from a config with 'defaults' and 'runs': each run is the defaults overridden by the run's entries, with the relative paths named in path_keys (if present) prefixed with stem.
INPUTS: - stem (str): project root, ending in '/' - config_file (str): data-states config, relative to stem or absolute - path_keys (iterable of str): keys holding paths relative to stem
OUTPUTS: - list[dict]: one merged dict per run

a.xlink:title:
Log an error if the max counts in image extension hdu_index (the raw readout, before background subtraction) exceed frac of the saturation level. Does not stop the analysis.
OUTPUTS: - bool: True if the check passed
a.text: Log an error if the max counts in

a.xlink:title:
Set up one run from a data state: its files (file_name_abs, or the file_name_pattern glob of the METIS-3300 steps, sorted by the STEP header card), their primary headers, and the limits and analysis parameters from the IMG-RAD-07 observing config (warning if a header's limit differs).
OUTPUTS: - PhotRunResult
a.text: Set up one run from a data state:

a.xlink:title:
Reduce the run's flats (BCKGD_SUBTED) one at a time: the field mask from the brightest (last) file, then per file the mean flux in the mask and its standard error, and the block mean / standard error maps.
OUTPUTS: - PhotRunResult, with exposure, flux, flux_sigma, block_means, block_sigmas

FYI plots in result.results_dir: METIS-2883 the B/mean - 1 block map; METIS-3300 the flux error per step (with the limit band) and the pattern-change map of the worst step; METIS-3291 S_empirical vs. S_perfect * alpha_fcn and the RSRF.
OUTPUTS: - list[str]: written plot files
a.text: map; METIS-3300 the flux error per

a.xlink:title:
Log the outcome of the run's requirement (as decided by metis_2883_check or metis_3300_check) and compare it with the injected truth (EXPECTED); a NOT EVALUATED verdict (METIS-2594, METIS-3291) is not compared.
OUTPUTS: - PhotRunResult, with verdict_overall and consistent set
a.text: Log the outcome of the run's

a.xlink:title:
Log a table of all runs (requirement, instrument, case, verdict, expected, consistency with the injected truth); METIS-2594 is NOT EVALUATED (no SIM data).
OUTPUTS: - int: number of runs inconsistent with the injected truth
a.text: Log a table of all runs

a.xlink:title: Load (once) the paths config from PATHS_FILE.

Load a YAML configuration file and pipe its contents to the log.
INPUTS ---------- config_file_choice : str Path to the configuration file. print_one_line : bool, optional If True, log the entire config on a single line. If False (default), log in a more readable, multiline format.
OUTPUTS ------- config_this : dict The configuration dictionary loaded from file.

a.xlink:title: One IMG-RAD-07 run (requirement, instrument, case), filled in by the stages.

Mean and standard error of the mean of the masked pixels of frame in square blocks of block_px; NaN for blocks with less than min_fill of their pixels in the mask (incomplete blocks at the frame edge are dropped).
OUTPUTS: - np.ndarray: block means - np.ndarray: block standard errors (std / sqrt(n))

mean of the masked pixels of frame
in square blocks of block_px; NaN

a.xlink:title:
Half peak-to-valley inhomogeneity max |B / mean(B) - 1| over the valid blocks, and its noise sigma (the relative standard error of the block where the max is).
OUTPUTS: - float: max |B / mean - 1| - float: sigma - np.ndarray: map of B / mean - 1
a.text: valid blocks, and its noise sigma
